name: long nose pliers
definition: pliers with slim tapering jaws for reaching into tight spaces, bending wire and gripping small parts.

name: cutting pliers
definition: pliers whose jaws are edged for cutting wire, including side cutters (diagonal cutters) and end cutters.

name: locking pliers
definition: pliers with a toggle-link mechanism that locks the jaws on the work, adjustable by a screw.

name: tongue and groove pliers
definition: pliers with a grooved joint giving several jaw widths, for large or irregular objects.

name: slip joint pliers
definition: pliers with a two-position joint that sets the jaw opening, for gripping and turning.

name: bar clamp
definition: clamp with a long bar, a fixed jaw and a sliding jaw, in F-style, quick-release and ratcheting forms.

name: C-clamp
definition: clamp with a C- or G-shaped frame and a screw that closes the jaw.

name: spring clamp
definition: clamp with two jaws closed by a spring, for light holding.

name: framing nailer
definition: nailer for structural work such as walls, decks and sheathing, driving large collated nails.

name: finish nailer
definition: nailer for trim and moulding, driving 15- or 16-gauge finish nails.

name: brad nailer
definition: nailer driving thin 18-gauge brads for light trim and small woodwork.

name: pin nailer
definition: nailer driving headless 23-gauge pins that leave almost invisible holes.

name: roofing and siding nailer
definition: coil nailer for fixing roofing shingles and siding.

name: flooring nailer
definition: nailer or nailer/stapler made to fix tongue-and-groove flooring.

name: palm nailer
definition: compact hand-held nailer that fits in the palm for tight spaces.

name: masonry drill bit
definition: drill bit with a carbide tip for brick, concrete and stone.

name: wood boring bit
definition: drill bit for wood, such as spade, auger, brad point and Forstner patterns.

name: hole saw
definition: ring-shaped toothed cutter with a pilot bit, for cutting large round holes.

name: step drill bit
definition: conical bit with stepped diameters that enlarges a hole in thin sheet.

name: circular saw blade
definition: toothed disc blade for a circular, mitre or table saw.

name: jigsaw blade
definition: narrow blade with a T-shank or U-shank for a jigsaw.

name: reciprocating saw blade
definition: long blade for a reciprocating saw.

name: band saw blade
definition: continuous toothed band for a bandsaw.
